{{Infobox location |image =Banner hideout.png |image size = |icon = |type = |prev = |next = |chapter = |enemies = |players = |difficulty = |duration = |notable loot = }} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' is the players' home. ==Description== The Hideout is initially found as an abandoned and cluttered bomb shelter without any means of sustaining life. The player can build and improve various modules to get access to extra features like crafting stations, additonal storage, a shooting range, a gym and character boosts. ==Notes== *Right mouse button in first person view will turn on a flashlight. *The Defective wall penalties are additive and mopping will reduce them for the current level. After upgrading the last level, the Defective wall will change into Gym with no penalties applied. *The Generator must be active to begin crafting in the Hideout. After the crafting has begun power can be turned off. This will increase the crafting time by more than 14 times. **The Lavatory does not require the generator to be active to begin crafting, and it does not increase the crafting time. *A list of all the possible crafts is available here: [[Crafts]] *Every item crafted in the Hideout will have the [[found in raid]] status. *Crafting items improves your [[Crafting |Crafting skill]] which decreases crafting time. *Crafting items and upgrading hideout zones improves your [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]] which in return improves bonuses, slot count, and consumption rates. *Every 1 fuel resource powers the Hideout for 12 minutes and 38 seconds (25 minutes and 16 seconds with the Solar Power module, also increased with the Hideout Management up to 33 minutes and 41 seconds). *The Generator must be running for the Illumination module levels 2 and 3 to work properly. Otherwise, the chosen lighting source will dim and flicker. ==Image Guides== [[File:Hideout-Requirements-Items-to-Keep.png|Hideout items to keep|300px|link={{filepath:Hideout-Requirements-Items-to-Keep.png}}]] [[File:Hideout flowchart.png|Hideout flowchart|300px|link={{filepath:Hideout flowchart.png}}]] ==Modules== {{Seasonal change|no items required for module upgrades need to be found in raid.}}

==Additional Modules Information== ===Gym=== To be able to start a training session you need to have at least 60 Energy and 60 Hydration. In a training session you can do up to 15 quick time events (QTE) where each successful one can randomly grant [[Strength]] or [[Endurance]] skill points based on your current skill level. For every successful QTE you lose 2 Energy and 2 Hydration, while for failing a QTE you lose 4 Energy and 4 Hydration. In order to do a QTE, you need to left-click the mouse when the shrinking hexagon hits the border of the inner hexagon, so that the border turns green. Failing to do so will result in a red border. The size of inner hexagon varies each attempt. After the first training session you get the [[File:Mildmusclepain.png|46px|Mild Muscle Pain]] effect for 24h where you can gain only 50% [[Strength]] and [[Endurance]] skill points in the next training session. After the second training session you get the [[File:Severemusclepain.png|46px|Severe Muscle Pain]] effect where you gain 0 skill points for both skills. When failing a QTE, there is a 10% chance to get a [[File:Fracture.png|46px|Fracture]] and stop the session. ===Hall of Fame=== The Hall of Fame gives skill leveling bonuses based on the amount and levels of stored opposing faction dogtags. The dogtag bonus is equal to the sum of levels divided by 5 and multiplied by the 0.1% bonus, where the decimal number is rounded up in favor of the player starting from level 3 (levels 3-7 = 0.1% bonus, levels 8-12 = 0.2% bonus). ===Bitcoin Farm=== The Bitcoin Farm produces [[Physical Bitcoin]]s at a rate of 1/(300000/(1+(GC-1)*0.041225)/3600) items/hour, where GC is the number of installed [[Graphics card]]s. Production stops if there are no installed graphics cards, the power is off, or there are 3 Bitcoins awaiting collection. (5 with Elite [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]]). The hour/Bitcoin rate of any given graphics card amount can be calculated with 300000/(1+(GC-1)*0.041225)/3600. ===Cultist Circle=== * You can sacrifice up to 5 items to the Cultist circle. * The base values (in ₽) of the sacrificed items are added up. * The total value determines the possible value of items received as gift from the Cultists. ** When the value of a sacrifice is ₽350,001 or more, there is an increased chance to receive rare and high value items. If the threshold is reached, the sacrifice will take 14 hours. ** When the value of a sacrifice is ₽400,000 or more, there is a 25% chance to receive items needed for active quests and unfinished Hideout modules. If the chance is triggered, the sacrifice will take 6 hours. If not, it will be 14 hours. ** The value of sacrificed items can be increased by 15% through placing a [[Sacred Amulet]] in the amulet slot (Each sacrifice consumes 1 use). *** The [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]] further increases the amulet bonus. =====Unique Sacrifices===== Some items trigger a special ritual with a unique outcome when they are sacrificed.
